one_line: Google’s Gemini leads, Nvidia releases model amid probe, AI regulation tightens worldwide.

themes.title: Google unveils Gemini 4 Carbon
themes.text: Google announced Gemini 4 Carbon, a frontier AI model that improves coding, agentic tasks and cybersecurity, scoring 89 points higher on WebDev Arena and ranking fourth. The model ranked #1 on the AI Index v5.0 and led several cybersecurity benchmarks.

stories.headline: Google announces Gemini 4 Carbon, a more capable frontier AI model not yet released
Gemini 4 Carbon ranks #1 on AI Index and leads cybersecurity benchmarks

themes.title: Nvidia releases model, faces probe
themes.text: Nvidia unveiled Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, a 30‑billion‑parameter open‑weight model that transcribes audio in up to 40 languages, translates 31 languages and distinguishes eight speakers, and released the Granary v2 speech dataset. The U.S. DOJ is probing Nvidia’s planned $12.93 billion acquisition of Hugging Face over competition concerns, and Nvidia shares fell about 1.7%.

stories.headline: Nvidia releases Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe and Granary v2 speech dataset
DOJ probes Nvidia's $13 billion Hugging Face acquisition

themes.title: AI regulation expands globally
themes.text: New York Governor Kathy Hochul signed bills banning unsafe AI chatbot features for users under 18 and imposing up to $25,000 civil penalties. China released draft rules adding 23 AI‑related technologies to its export‑control list, requiring government approval for transfers. OpenAI set up an election “war room” to monitor misinformation ahead of the U.S. midterm elections.

stories.headline: New York governor signs law banning unsafe AI chatbot features for minors
China proposes export controls on 23 AI technologies
OpenAI launches election war room to monitor misinformation ahead of US midterms
